C0040.title: Minor Sentenced for Online Store Fraud via Fake Shipments
C0040.summary: On May 15, 2025, the People's Court of Yongxin County, Jiangxi, tried a case involving a minor surnamed Wang who defrauded victims by issuing fake shipments through an online store. Wang obtained property from victims in substantial amounts, constituting the crime of fraud.
